name: GHOST SIX
source: Strange disappearances have been occurring at Hazama Station. Tsutsuji and Sumire investigate the supernatural phenomenon in order to repay a debt, uncovering disturbing mysteries along the way.
translation: Strange disappearances have been occurring at Hazama Station. Tsutsuji and Sumire investigate the supernatural phenomenon in order to repay a debt, uncovering disturbing mysteries along the way.
